name: v152_cfi_update_cap60_market

expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.60, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63)), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_cfi_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfi_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Primary TOP1000 robustness repair of mL87NgRK; strict-check against omKWa3jn/omKarE8m/O0p8JGJq if platform checks pass.
